in_marathi.name: Vedansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vedansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Vedansh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Veda' meaning knowledge and 'Ansh' meaning part or manifestation. It is a name that signifies the embodiment of knowledge and wisdom. Vedansh is a name that is deeply rooted in Hindu spirituality and symbolizes the pursuit of knowledge and the quest for self-realization.
